blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Reserve Bank of India was established on April 1, 1935, based on the recommendations of the Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance (Hilton Young Commission, 1926).
The institution was constituted under the legal framework of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
Initially established as a private shareholders' bank, RBI was nationalized on January 1, 1949, under the RBI (Transfer to Public Ownership) Act, 1948.
The Central Office was originally established in Kolkata but permanently relocated to Mumbai in 1937.
Hilton Young Commission (1926) is frequently asked as the recommending body for the creation of India's central bank.
Differentiate between RBI Act 1934 (governs central bank functions) and Banking Regulation Act 1949 (governs commercial bank operations).
Exact nationalization date (January 1, 1949) is a standard high-frequency question in competitive exams.
